pisteCiclabili.descrizione1: in Friuli Venezia Giulia — 6 independent sources: the 4 coded turismofvg.it series (Loops, Linear routes, Multi-day cycleways, Mountain biking), the Autonomous Region of FVG (dati.friuliveneziagiulia.it) and the historic Ciclovie 2020 dataset.
pisteCiclabili.descrizione2: Independent sources, never merged together — each source has its own box below and its own colour on the map. The turismofvg.it routes (code in brackets, e.g. "R001") are official tourist routes with a complete track and technical data (length, elevation gain, difficulty, duration) read from each route's own page, plus a direct link to download the GPX file. The Region FVG data, on the other hand, has partial coverage (only tracks submitted by municipalities through a specific planning procedure, not a complete survey — for example, the Trieste area is not covered) and may be split into several segments, with the departure/arrival municipality and province calculated from the coordinates where possible. Ciclovie 2020 is instead a historic dataset, frozen at January 2020 (complete regional coverage, including Trieste) — shown as a context layer, not as the current state of the network.
